website.note: Corporate site lists product/manufacturing programs (Unity Imaging Platform, single-use endoscopes, micro-optics for defense/aerospace). No clinical-trial pipeline page exists.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Precision Optics is a contract designer and manufacturer of advanced optical instruments (endoscopes, micro-optics, imaging assemblies) for medical-device OEM customers and defense/aerospace customers. It does not own or sponsor proprietary drug or device clinical trials; its product development pipeline consists of customer-funded engineering programs that transition to commercial manufacturing rather than P1/P2/P3 clinical studies.
